title: File:Wat Tham Chiang Dao (II).jpg
claims: The photograph shows the entrance area of Wat Tham Chiang Dao: a low temple building with a steep tiled roof and ornate gable, two tall decorated figures, a metal fence, tropical palms and a limestone cave entrance behind; a stream runs across the foreground.

Commons titles the file Wat Tham Chiang Dao (II).jpg; the picture shows the temple setting used as the 2026 CHIANG DAO 160 start, not a race arch, timing mat, aid table, course marker or race-day crowd.

The author is Supanut Arunoprayote; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2022-09-20 at 15:13:23; the original is 6,337 x 4,225 pixels and 14,474,893 bytes; the file page gives a camera location of 19.394640 N, 98.929168 E.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 315,456 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Supanut Arunoprayote, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
